reviews.title: Annoying Reset button
reviews.text: It is one of the best tasbih among many options available. But one of the major drawback is that the reset button. It’s right above the main counting button and if we keep doing tasbih and if we see here and there many times happens that we press reset button and the count becomes zero. I have set target of making Dhikr (astagfirulla) one million times but always I end up pressing reset button and again I have to start from beginning. Can you lock the reset button with option to password or place the reset button somewhere else far from count button? I had restarted unfortunately one time at 186k another time at 134k and now at 120k. It’s really annoying to start from zero again
